profile.headline: Software Engineer at DocuSign
profile.summary:
I graduated the University of Washington in Seattle with a B.S. in Informatics in 2021. I am passionate about solving on information-related technology problems and continuing my pursuit of developing a career in software development (front-end, full-stack, etc.). I would look to take on an opportunity that can help me grow as an individual and push my career forward.

Some technical skills that I have learned through my course work and college experiences are Java, Python, R, HTML, CSS, SQL, Go, JavaScript, React.js, etc.. Additionally, in my Informatics courses I have worked on multiple projects to create a real world products that solve an information issue. Through these projects I've gained experience and knowledge with brainstorming, designing, and implementing software. I have also further developed my team work and communication skills. 

From my time at DocuSign, I worked on large scale projects such as CLM Essentials and was able to help the team ship the product. I learned technical skills such as C#, React.js, JIRA, etc., as well as communication, teamwork, and feature ownership. Additionally, I worked on the Agreement Orchestration Workflows team and helped the team build new features. I learned how to write design specs, work collaboratively, and further honed my technical skills in React.js and Node.js.

Some of my passions include learning new things, art, video games, and tennis. I enjoy learning new things because of the challenges presented and the opportunity to grow as an individual.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Essential to the shipment of DS’s Maestro by owning and building the workflow management UI functionality, including the workflow definitions page, workflow instances page, and workflow monitoring page.
•	Created and contributed to documentation for on-call, team onboarding, and playwright tests.
•	Consistently reviews PRs and leaves feedback as needed, as well as implements any PR feedback from the team to improve code.
•	Participated in on-call rotations by answering questions related to Maestro, identifying errors using Kazmon and reaching out to the necessary people in order to help resolve issues.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · Azure Logic Apps · .NET Framework · JavaScript · Jest

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: •	Enhanced the mobile view of the onboarding procedure for clients through building out UI components such as collecting information through user input, updating the header, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Jest · React.js · Tailwind CSS · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Developer in DocuSign Rotation Program
positions.description:
•	Built and delivered the landing page of DS’s CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) Essentials for managing and monitoring workflows, using Typescript and React.js for the UI and C# to build the APIs and data models.
•	Contributed to the development of DS’s orchestration platform’s workflow monitoring using Typescript, React.js, and Node.js to build the UI, APIs, data models, and unit tests. 
•	Consistently demoed work to the team and made improvements based off of feedback.
•	Proactively collaborated with fellow team members, UX designers, and product managers to learn and understand the code base, relevant technologies, UI designs, and product requirements.
•	Communicated frequently with manager and mentor to gain feedback on performance, design specs, and code reviews.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Node.js · React.js · JavaScript · C#

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
•	To establish a platform for sustainable business growth, I worked to develop and establish the website from the ground up using HTML, CSS, JS/React for the client-side and Firebase for hosting.
•	Collaborated with a team of developers and implemented a mobile-first approach to develop the new website.
•	Collaborated with the UX team to enhance user experience on the website.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
•	Helped establish the website using AWS and updated previous HTML/CSS/JS code to reflect new officers, events, etc. in order to increase student engagement through enhanced UI/UX.
•	Created workshops on Python, SQL, Tableau, and other useful technology tools to teach club members new skills.
•	Collaborated with other clubs to create workshops and events for club members.

positions.title: Technical Officer
positions.description: Manage social media networking and aid in creating workshops and presenting. These workshops include an introduction to SQL, Tableau, predictive analytics, and more.

positions.title: Systems Consultant / Web Tools Consultant
positions.description:
•	Managed 500+ Mac and PC based systems through Jamf MDM.
•	Learned Git, scrum development, client support, and other relevant soft skills in order to provide UW students and faculty with adequate technology.
•	Wrote command lines and Python scripts to automate the computer naming process.
•	Provided IT support on Canvas through ServiceNow to assist students, professors, and other UW affiliates.
•	Communicate frequently with team leads to gain feedback on tickets and workflow.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
•	Delivered $1.2 M in potential revenue recommendations for targeted inventory categories to product managers and directors.
•	Pulled data from siloed resources and developed a regression model to predict operating hours on asset installed base using Python.

positions.title: Frontend Developer Research Position
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with UX designers and other student developers to develop the website in React.
•	Creating new React components to transition from their legacy webpages.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
•	Used Python (beautifulsoup, pandas, urllib, etc.) to develop a web scraper and pull job data from Indeed to populate an app created for high school students to find entry level jobs.
•	Designed portions of the app using Axure with the focus of making the app centered around user experience.

positions.title: Software and Engineering Research Intern
positions.description: Contributed to 3D printing with ceramics research through coding, 3D modeling (Rhino 6, Fusion 360, Maya), creating and designing a prototype device, and hands on work with ceramics.

positions.title: Member of Data Science Mentorship Program
positions.description: Learned introductory SQL, PowerBI, data wrangling, web scraping, and more through workshops and mentorship.

positions.title: Employee
positions.description: Customer service including, cash register and serving food.

positions.title: Assistant Tennis Instructor
positions.description: Assisting in professional instructing junior classes, hitting tennis balls, court equipment handling, office work.

projects.title: DubHacks
projects.description: Competed in DubHacks and brainstormed and developed an app prototype that connects the homeless population of Seattle with vacant Airbnbs.

projects.title: Alaska Airlines Environmental Innovation Challenge
projects.description: Collaborated with teammates to replace an existing product that is harmful to the environment. Together we worked to replace PLU stickers by creating a business plan and prototype, as well as pitched to judges.
